Built for Nigerian weather

Roofing tips & on-site workmanship

A good roof starts with proper planning, suitable materials and safe installation.

Professional roofing work for homes across Nigeria.

5 useful roofing tips

  1. Choose suitable sheets: compare material quality, thickness and coating for your location and budget.
  2. Get the roof pitch right: plan drainage to reduce standing water and leaks.
  3. Use the right fasteners: follow the roofing manufacturer's fixing pattern and use suitable washers.
  4. Check the framework: make sure the roof structure is properly designed and sound before installation.
  5. Prioritize safety: use trained installers, fall protection and safe access equipment.

Every roof is different. Ask a qualified roofing professional to assess your building before work begins.
